pricing.title: Pricing & margin
pricing.sub: Minimum selling price per case from your monthly expenses and volume.
pricing.overCapacity: Planned volume is more than your trucks can carry ({{n}} cases a month). Add a truck or more trips.
pricing.how: Minimum = buy price + cost per case: below it you lose money once expenses are counted. Floor = buy price + loading and cash discount: only to fill empty truck space. The trade price is the most a shop pays, so the case columns never go above it. A discount is given only while the price stays at or above the minimum. If the minimum is higher than the trade price, no discount is possible and you sell at the trade price (a loss after expenses).
pricing.legend: Buy price = your real purchase cost, or the Pepsi portal price if not bought yet. * Not on the portal either: assumed trade price minus {{m}}. Red margin: below cost per case. Green: room to discount.
pricing.defaultMargin: Assumed margin ₹ per case (when buy price unknown)
pricing.slabApplied: {{n}} cases in this order: volume discount {{off}} per case applied (not below each minimum).
pricing.belowFloorBody: {{n}} items are priced below the floor. You lose money on every case. Save anyway?

pepsi.title: Pepsi portal
pepsi.sub: Copied every morning from Varun Beverages’ distributor portal: your credit, Pepsi’s price for each item and your orders there. Read-only.
pepsi.stale: Not synced since {{at}}. The morning job retries; check the Telegram group for errors.
pepsi.onlyIssues: Only items not on the portal
pepsi.unmatchedTitle: {{n}} item(s) not found on the Pepsi portal
pepsi.unmatchedHelp: Pick the matching Pepsi item so costs, weights and invoices line up. Everything else is matched automatically.
pepsi.saved: Saved. The next sync keeps your choice.
pepsi.how: Our cost is the average of what we paid on purchases. Old stock keeps its old cost and rate; new stock comes at Pepsi’s new price, and its cost is recorded when you enter the new purchase. The difference column is only a note on how much more or less Pepsi charges now.
pepsi.noOrders: No orders on the portal yet.
pepsi.ordersHow: Orange = Pepsi changed the quantity you asked for. Cases.
pepsi.noInvoices: No invoices in the last 60 days.
pepsi.invHow: The portal shows the amount before GST. The amount with GST is calculated from Pepsi’s GST per case and matches your booked purchase within ₹2. Tap an invoice for its items.
pepsi.unbooked: {{n}} Pepsi invoice(s) are not entered as purchases yet: {{list}}. Enter them in Purchases so stock and costs are right.
pepsi.specialHow: Pepsi marks some order lines as a special type. Near Expiry is stock close to its expiry date, usually cheaper: check the date when it arrives and sell it first. Specific MRP is stock printed with a particular MRP (for example a promo pack). Filler is stock added to fill the truck. “Asked” is the quantity on the order, “Got” is what Pepsi allocated and invoiced.
pepsi.mbNone: Pepsi has not set a quantity yet (the items are listed once it does)
pepsi.targetsHow: From Pepsi’s Must Bill and Range reports. We do not yet know what these earn: ask your Pepsi contact. You get a Telegram message when Pepsi sets a Must Bill quantity.
pepsi.invoiceShort: Invoice …{{no}} · {{on}} · {{n}} cases · {{g}} with GST ({{v}} before GST)
pepsi.deadShow: Show {{n}} cancelled or short-closed orders (never delivered)
pepsi.noSpecial: No Near Expiry, Specific MRP or filler lines in the last 60 days.

srep.title: Sales report
srep.sub: Everything sold: items, cases, amount, shops and days. Live, any period. Download as PDF to share.
srep.badRange: Pick a From date on or before the To date.
srep.error: Could not load the report. Try again.
srep.note: Counter bills, truck bills and delivered route orders; cancelled bills left out. Amounts include GST as billed. Item amounts are before bill discounts. Margin = selling price − our buy price, before salaries, fuel and other costs (see Kharcha). The same PDF goes to the Telegram group every Monday (last week) and on the 1st (last month); type "sales report" in the group for one any time.
